step_4_life_story_and_interests.occupation: Retired High School Mathematics Teacher (Guwahati Govt Boys' High School, Panbazar)
step_4_life_story_and_interests.favorite_music_or_artists: Dr. Bhupen Hazarika songs (Manuhe Manuhor Babe, Gonga Mur Maa), Jayanta Hazarika, Zubeen Garg classic melodies.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.cultural_background: Assamese Hindu; celebrates Rongali & Magh Bihu; daily evening prayers at local Namghar; wears traditional Gamosa.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.what_brings_them_joy: Listening to Dr. Bhupen Hazarika vinyl records, sitting under the courtyard mango tree sipping warm Lal Saah (red tea), and seeing old photo albums.
